g.text: How do people spend their time?

text.style: font-size: 11.52px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b5b5b

g.text: Averages of minutes per day, from time-use surveys run between 2010 and 2024, for people aged 15 to 64.

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #858585

g.text: Note: Each country's most recent time-use survey is shown, with its year in brackets; survey years range from 2010 to 2024. Estimates cover people aged

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #858585

g.text: 15 to 64. Education covers time in school and studying; other unpaid work covers care work and volunteering.
